corpus_meta.name: GetHired Cybersecurity Fresher Corpus
corpus_meta.scope: Entry-level / 0-1 years experience cybersecurity roles only (India-focused)
roles_explicitly_excluded: SOC L2/L3, Senior, or Lead roles of any kind
corpus_meta.sample_size_note: This pass pulled skill-tag data from roughly 120+ distinct postings surfaced across ~19 targeted searches (Glassdoor India, Indeed India/US, Naukri-aggregator reports) covering Chennai, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Kerala, Hyderabad, and general India/US listings. Weights below are counted from how often each skill appeared across those listings' structured 'Skills:' tags and description text, not from a full raw scrape. This is a meaningfully larger and more systematic sample than v0.1, but is still search-engine-mediated (snippets + aggregator pages), not a deduplicated database.
corpus_meta.known_limitation: For statistically rigorous, continuously-refreshed accuracy at true scale, this should be replaced by the planned GitHub Action job that queries a job-postings API (e.g. Adzuna) directly and computes frequency from full posting text on a schedule. This file is a strong seed corpus, not a substitute for that pipeline.
sources: Glassdoor India (city-filtered: Chennai, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Kerala, Hyderabad, India-wide)
Naukri (via aggregator report citing 229 live fresher postings)
Company-adjacent postings (Wipro, TCS, Deloitte, IBM via career/job-board mirrors)
